summary: The merged plan prioritizes continuity while incorporating later operational decisions. Configure role-based groups for administrators, regional managers, permissions, management approvals, and website access; preserve property-specific student lease calendars while adding and pricing future terms; use Homebody as the resident destination; allow partial balance payments; retain tracked phone numbers and lead attribution; configure paid parking as recurring rentable inventory; use one student application with manual screening-package selection; and maintain Blue Moon lease forms and packets. Later calls supersede two earlier assumptions: Entrata ResidentUtility replaced the broad Vego assumption for the three selected properties, and the earlier rent-last allocation decision must be reconfirmed because the later partial-payment review did not approve a final allocation order.
